visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a montage of a young male, Peter, in a bright bedroom setting. He is wearing a white T-shirt and blue jeans, holding a sleek purple L-shaped hair dryer. Large yellow Traditional Chinese text overlays the scene. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) Peter sits at a table, talking directly to the camera with a friendly expression. He uses hand gestures to emphasize his points. Behind him is a modern bedroom with a large bed, light wood paneling, and an arched doorway. (3) He brings the hair dryer, a Dyson Supersonic r, close to the lens to show its unique shape and metallic finish. The camera captures a close-up of the device's head and handle. (4) He demonstrates the magnetic attachments, clicking various nozzles onto the head of the dryer. His hands are in close-up, showing the precision of the fit. (5) He turns the device to show the control panel on the back, where small red LED lights indicate different heat and wind speed levels. He presses the buttons with his thumb. (6) He uses a spray bottle to wet his short dark hair until it appears damp and flat. He then begins to dry it using the hair dryer, moving it rhythmically around his head. (7) He uses a specific nozzle to dry the back of his head, showing how the curved design fits the contour of his neck and skull. He looks into the camera as he styles. (8) After drying, his hair appears voluminous and styled. He touches his hair to show the texture. (9) He puts on a silver necklace and then dons a black blazer over his white T-shirt. He checks his reflection in the camera. (10) He delivers a final sign-off with a smile, adjusts his hair one last time, and waves goodbye.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring guitar and light percussion begins. Peter speaks in a friendly, clear male voice, discussing his busy daily schedule with moderate energy and consistent pitch. (2) A sharp, metallic 'click' sound is heard as he attaches the first magnetic nozzle to the hair dryer. His voice remains clear and informative, maintaining a professional narrative tone over the BGM. (3) Another 'click' occurs as he demonstrates a second nozzle. The speaker's arousal increases slightly as he introduces the Dyson brand and the device's lightweight characteristics. (4) The high-pitched whirring of a high-speed hair dryer motor begins. The BGM ducks in volume to allow the motor sound and Peter's explanation to be audible. (5) A series of 'clicks' are heard as he demonstrates the settings on the back panel. The motor's pitch changes subtly, indicating a shift in wind and heat modes. (6) The motor stops, and a soft splashing or spraying sound of water is heard. Peter continues his vocal narrative, explaining the importance of drying hair correctly for health and style. (7) The motor sound returns as he dries his hair. The percussive quality of the air flow competes with the BGM, but his voice remains the dominant signal. (8) A soft rustling sound of fabric is heard as he puts on a blazer. The motor is silent now. He gives a final, high-valence closing statement, and the music fades out quickly.
